description: QECIO Cycling Infrastructure Tracker provides cycling-infrastructure indicators and OpenStreetMap-derived cycle networks, supplied as summary CSV and national GeoPackage bundles containing NUTS 3 regions. The provider is European Cyclists Federation. Geographical and temporal coverage: The European Cyclists' Federation page lists European countries. It does not claim every local cycling facility is mapped. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The provider states that local-road-network files for checking contraflow analysis are available on request; other listed files have download links. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
